```sql
WITH checks_clean AS (
    -- Skipped checks are invisible to this report.
    SELECT
        service,
        checked_at,
        CASE WHEN status IN ('fail', 'timeout') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_fail,
        CASE WHEN status = 'ok' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_ok
    FROM checks
    WHERE status <> 'skipped'
),

checks_with_prev AS (
    SELECT
        service,
        checked_at,
        is_fail,
        is_ok,
        LAG(is_fail) OVER (
            PARTITION BY service
            ORDER BY checked_at
        ) AS prev_is_fail
    FROM checks_clean
),

run_islands AS (
    SELECT
        service,
        checked_at,
        is_fail,
        is_ok,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN is_fail = 1 AND COALESCE(prev_is_fail, 0) = 0 THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) OVER (
            PARTITION BY service
            ORDER BY checked_at
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS run_id
    FROM checks_with_prev
),

run_stats AS (
    SELECT
        service,
        run_id,
        MIN(CASE WHEN is_fail = 1 THEN checked_at END) AS run_started_at,
        MIN(CASE WHEN is_ok = 1 THEN checked_at END) AS recovery_at,
        SUM(is_fail) AS failed_checks
    FROM run_islands
    GROUP BY service, run_id
    HAVING SUM(is_fail) > 0
),

service_last AS (
    SELECT
        service,
        MAX(checked_at) AS last_non_skipped_at
    FROM checks_clean
    GROUP BY service
),

runs_with_prev_recovery AS (
    SELECT
        service,
        run_started_at,
        recovery_at,
        failed_checks,
        LAG(recovery_at) OVER (
            PARTITION BY service
            ORDER BY run_started_at
        ) AS prev_recovery_at
    FROM run_stats
),

episode_islands AS (
    SELECT
        service,
        run_started_at,
        recovery_at,
        failed_checks,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN prev_recovery_at IS NULL
                     OR run_started_at - prev_recovery_at >= 10 THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) OVER (
            PARTITION BY service
            ORDER BY run_started_at
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS episode_id
    FROM runs_with_prev_recovery
),

episode_numbered AS (
    SELECT
        service,
        episode_id,
        run_started_at,
        recovery_at,
        failed_checks,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY service, episode_id
            ORDER BY run_started_at
        ) AS run_seq,
        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY service, episode_id
        ) AS run_count
    FROM episode_islands
),

episode_stats AS (
    SELECT
        service,
        episode_id,
        MIN(run_started_at) AS started_at,
        MAX(CASE WHEN run_seq = run_count THEN recovery_at END) AS ended_at,
        SUM(failed_checks) AS failed_checks
    FROM episode_numbered
    GROUP BY service, episode_id
),

episode_duration AS (
    SELECT
        e.service,
        e.started_at,
        e.ended_at,
        CASE
            WHEN e.ended_at IS NOT NULL THEN e.ended_at - e.started_at
            ELSE sl.last_non_skipped_at - e.started_at
        END AS duration_min,
        e.failed_checks
    FROM episode_stats e
    JOIN service_last sl ON sl.service = e.service
),

reportable AS (
    SELECT
        service,
        started_at,
        ended_at,
        duration_min,
        failed_checks
    FROM episode_duration
    WHERE ended_at IS NULL OR duration_min >= 15
)

SELECT
    service,
    started_at,
    ended_at,
    duration_min,
    failed_checks,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY service
        ORDER BY duration_min DESC, started_at ASC
    ) AS severity_rank
FROM reportable
ORDER BY service, started_at;
```
